newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Roly buys rights to HFC for US$1.5 mln.
newsitem.headline: Roly buys rights to HFC for US$1.5 mln.

text.p: Home decor company Roly International Holdings Ltd (Roly) said on Tuesday it had signed a deal to buy the rights to brands, publications and television programmes of the U.S. Home Furnishing Council Inc (HFC).

"This acquisition will enable us to diversify into a new and potentially lucrative market ie. America's middle-class, arguably the biggest spenders on home decor in the U.S.," said Roly chairman Robert Wang in a statement.
Wang said the US$1.5 million deal would also allow Roly to evolve its product line from mass merchandising to branded products and achieve higher margins.
It would also bring new income to the group from branding, licensing, custom manufacturing, marketing, television and print media advertising.
Funds for the deal would come from internal sources, Roly said.
HFC was expected to add US$600,000 to Roly pre-tax earnings in the 1999 financial year, the statement added.
Roly recorded net earnings of US$16.4 million in the year to April 30 1996.
